findings.where: Article specimen, the pull quote (“Whichever PPP Law I am currently working on with a client country!”), at both widths
findings.fault: The pull quote is set in logo blue, the same blue the page uses for its links and its one button. The palette swatch says blue means 'wordmark, links, the button', but here a whole static passage wears it too. A reader can't tell from colour alone what they can click. On the article page the quote sits just above an underlined blue link, so it looks like one, and blue stops meaning 'act here'.
findings.who_objects: A development-bank reader on an article page, who may click or tap the blue quote and get nothing. The next rounds and Angélique would object too: if they inherit this rule, every pull quote she adds to a post is blue, which wears down the one colour that marks the 'Get in touch' button and the links.
